name: hardening 4/5: receipt-is-closing-commit and bus-RELEASE become enforced orchestrator close gates (spawn W5-HCRUX-GATE)

source.anchor: Joe word 2026-08-16: hardening pass from first principles - failure history becomes enforced gates

targets: 1) read orchestrate.ps1 close/state region and bus.py; the mandate exists in prose and crux checks - make the state machine refuse it

2) a leg only transitions to done when: its receipt file exists on its branch, the receipt commit IS the branch HEAD, and a RELEASE line for its claim exists on the bus; otherwise state holds at closing with a Notify naming exactly what is missing
3) SPEC-surgical: wrap the existing state read, never rebuild it; dry-run must exercise the same checks
4) prove with a scratch leg that violates each condition in turn - three refusals, three exact messages, then a clean pass
5) BUS MANDATE: post claim at start, findings to peers as you resolve shared facts, explicit RELEASE at close. W6-GATE is making this enforceable - model it.
crucible_criteria: coordinate with W6-QUOTE on the bus for any orchestrate.ps1 line overlap - GATE owns the close-state region only
three-refusal proof is first-hand stdout; receipt is own closing commit; RELEASE posted

acceptance.predicate: done requires receipt==HEAD + RELEASE; three violation refusals with exact messages
clean leg passes the new gates end to end in dry-run

note: Folded HELD spawn W5-HCRUX-GATE on Joe hardening directive - flagged for pull before unblock.
